martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, cycling looks great today, especially between 09:00–11:00 when it's a pleasant 25°C with calm winds. You might even convince Britt to drag the bikes out of the camper and join you for a spin. Temperatures will soar later, so make the most of the morning — you can always reward yourselves with a cold one afterwards.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, cycling looks perfect today, especially between 09:00 and 11:00 when it's a nice 25°C with calm winds. Maybe drag Martha along for a ride and then grab a drink on the terrace afterwards? It's supposed to get pretty warm later, so make the most of the morning.
